headline: 5 confirmed GTA 6 facts
title: 5 Confirmed GTA 6 Facts | Release Date, Vice City, Lucia and Jason | Gaming News
video_script: Five confirmed facts about GTA 6. One, it releases on November nineteenth, twenty twenty six. Two, it is coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Three, the story is set in Vice City, in the state of Leonida. Four, there are two lead characters, Lucia and Jason. And five, pre-loading starts on November twelfth. Are you playing on launch day? Comment below!
description: GTA 6 releases November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Set in Vice City, Leonida, with Lucia and Jason. Pre-loading from November 12.
